# Public legacy replay fixture

These three exact JSON files retain an earlier public assessment of Unit 3, 9 Jardine Street, Kingston, ACT. They contain official public register observations and no household financial amounts. `case-input.json` has an empty finance object. Their exact bytes are needed to test replay of the archived pre-offer version 1.0.0 result. They were copied from the local public preview fixture; private databases, API credentials and other runtime captures are excluded.
